test_intent: Verify MessageHandler handles moderation service errors gracefully without propagating exceptions and logs the error.
reason: Useful error-handling behavior but tested through 4 mock setups and legacy MessageHandlerTestFactory. DoesNotThrow is a weak assertion; the LoggerMock.Verify for error logging is the real signal. A simpler contract test with minimal mock arrangement at the MessageHandler seam would be more maintainable.

test_intent: Verify that a suspicious user first message triggers AI analysis through the MessageHandler pipeline.
reason: Assertion is NotBeNull on a handler you just created. Contains Console.WriteLine debug output instead of real assertions. Does not verify AI analysis was triggered. No meaningful behavior value. Heavy factory setup for zero signal.

test_intent: Verify MessageHandler sends notification for suspicious user messages through the AI analysis pipeline.
reason: Only asserts handler is not null and fake bot has sent messages. SentMessages.NotBeEmpty is too broad to verify notification content, recipient, or format. Does not test notification behavior at the correct seam.

test_intent: Verify that channel messages do not trigger captcha flow.
reason: Name says should not show captcha but assertions only check handler not null and fake bot sent messages. Does not verify captcha was NOT shown. Misleading test name vs actual assertions. Should be tested at CaptchaService or pipeline step seam.

test_intent: Verify that repeated messages from the same user do not re-trigger AI analysis.
reason: Name says should not trigger analysis but only asserts handler not null and fake bot sent messages. Does not verify AI analysis was skipped. No deduplication behavior is tested. Should be tested at the pipeline step or AI checks seam.

test_intent: Verify that the operation order for suspicious user message processing is correct.
reason: Name says operation order should be correct but only asserts handler not null and fake bot sent messages. No ordering assertions whatsoever. Does not test operation sequence. Should be tested at the pipeline seam with ordered step verification.

test_intent: Verify that photo messages with captions are included in AI profile analysis.
reason: Name says should include photo but the constructed message has no photo field set (only Text). Assertions only check handler not null and fake bot sent messages. Does not test photo handling at all. Should be tested at the AI checks seam with actual photo metadata.
